meta.name: frame-glitch-title
meta.description: 数字故障 / 像散偏移 / 数据腐败标题, 适合视频转场 / cyberpunk hero

copy.tagline: 给视频添加数字故障风格标题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做视频需要炫酷的故障艺术标题
copy.tagline_en: Add glitch-style titles to your videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need cool glitch art titles for videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按“故障艺术标题帧”模板生成一个单文件 HTML 标题画面：包含居中的大标题、青/品红像散偏移、切片抖动、扫描线、噪点、ASCII 噪点、时间码等，用于视频转场或 cyberpunk 风格标题。
howto.when: 当你说出“数字故障”“像散偏移”“数据腐败”等关键词，或要求做“cyberpunk hero”风格的视频标题帧/转场时触发。

say.text: 生成一个像散偏移风格的标题帧，副标是‘CH-04’，加时间码。
say.note: 添加青/品红偏移及叠加元素。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude generates a single-file HTML glitch title frame with centered big title, cyan/magenta aberration, sliced jitter, scanlines, noise, ASCII noise, timecode, for video transitions or cyberpunk-style titles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'digital glitch', 'astigmatism offset', 'data corruption', or ask for a 'cyberpunk hero' style video title frame/transition.

say_en.text: Use frame-glitch-title to make a glitch title with main text 'SIGNAL_LOST'.
say_en.note: Generates a title frame with data corruption artifacts.

say_en.text: Create an astigmatism-offset title frame with subtitle 'CH-04' and timecode.
say_en.note: Adds cyan/magenta shift and overlay elements.

say_en.text: Make a cyberpunk hero style video transition title with text 'NEON CITY'.
say_en.note: Produces a glitch-style title with scanlines and noise.
